t: This is Kenwood House, a stately home on the northern edge of Hampstead Heath, now an art museum. The present house dates from the late seventeenth century. It was remodelled in the eighteenth century for William Murray, the first Earl of Mansfield, by the Scottish architect Robert Adam, and the Earls of Mansfield lived here until the twentieth century. The third Earl, David William Murray, lived here from 1793. General Sir Charles Stuart was born here, and Grand Duke Michael Mikhailovich of Russia lived here from 1909. The architect William Atkinson also designed work here.
